coder_notes: The record never states the target of RO7428731 in words; the EGFRvIII match rests on the title and design (EGFRvIII-expressing glioblastoma, exclusion of prior anti-EGFRvIII-targeting agents), and the biologic nature is inferred from the immunoglobulin hypersensitivity exclusion. Part II enrols only MGMT-unmethylated tumours; Part I allows both methylated and unmethylated. Pharmacodynamics appears only in the title and is not linked to a stated measurement, hence target_engagement unclear. Serum PK only.
